modifiers.message: You've grown so familiar with the swing of your pickaxe that even with your feet off the ground, your strikes land cleanly. The air beneath you no longer hinders your swing. (+1 Airborne)
With countless strikes, you have mastered the balance of your pickaxe. Your swings come faster now, with stone and earth giving way before you can even register the impact. (+1 Haste)
After breaking countless blocks, your pickaxe has begun to hum with a quiet pull. Debris is drawn toward you now, rather than scattering to the ground. (+1 Magnetic)
You have meticulously maintained your pickaxe, and your careful attention has paid off. As long as it stays in good repair, your mining will be swifter. (+1 Maintained)

You have learned the rhythm of your pickaxe, each swing feeding into the next with greater ease. Every block you shatter quickens the next swing, building a cadence that grows faster the longer you keep mining. (+1 Momentum)
Through careful use and growing familiarity, you've learned to work with the grain of your pickaxe rather than against it. It holds together longer now, and mends more easily. (+1 Preserved)
Long hours of use have tempered your pickaxe beyond how it was forged. Its edge holds firmer now, less likely to wear with each strike you land. (+1 Reinforced)

Through careful use and growing familiarity, you've learned to move in your helmet rather than grinding it against itself. It holds together longer now, and mends more easily. (+1 Preserved)
You've grown attuned to the whistle of incoming fire and learned to angle away from it. Your helmet catches arrows better now, turning direct hits into glancing blows. (+1 Projectile Protection)
Experience has taught you where to take a hit and how to roll with one you can't avoid. Your helmet absorbs damage better now, reducing harm from all sources. (+1 Protection)

Your reflexes heighten and your resolve hardens in response to crisis. For a brief moment after taking a hit, your helmet braces against the next blow, reducing the damage you take. (+1 Recurrent Protection)
Dent by dent, your helmet has settled into something stronger than its original form. It resists wear more stubbornly now, less likely to take lasting damage from blows. (+1 Reinforced)
You've faced enough creatures born of fire to know how they burn. Your helmet has been tempered by their particular heat, reducing the damage they deal. (+1 Scorch Protection)
The pattern of wear on your helmet has left jagged edges and sharp ridges that punish contact. Anything that strikes you will regret the attempt. (+1 Thorns)
